title: Exploring Human Perceptions of AI Responses: Insights from a Mixed-Methods Study on Risk Mitigation in Generative Models
reasoning: The study evaluates AI responses through the lens of 'social value alignment' and explicitly uses evaluation criteria such as 'fairness' and 'moral values.' It includes prompts that specifically ask the AI (and human evaluators) to determine the 'most moral thing to do' in complex scenarios.
